string.text: {=tor_engineer_rank1}Apprentice Engineer
{=tor_engineer_rank2}Field Engineer
{=tor_engineer_rank3}Master Engineer
{=tor_engineer_desc}Engineers turn powder, steel and measurement into battlefield doctrine. They fight through firearms, ammunition discipline, armor penetration and experimental shot.
{=tor_engineer_root}Firearm damage fills Open Fire!, then a 15s firing order follows.
{=tor_engineer_powder_key}Open Fire! lasts longer; Gunpowder tightens the drill.
{=tor_engineer_powder_p1}+6 ammo per pouch. Every cartridge has its place.
{=tor_engineer_powder_p2}+10% gunpowder damage. Better powder, louder answers.
{=tor_engineer_powder_p3}+30% firearm accuracy. Rifling, gauges and steady hands.
{=tor_engineer_powder_p4}Ranged troops gain +25 Gunpowder from your field drills.
{=tor_engineer_field_key}Open Fire! hardens the line; Athletics improves the brace.
{=tor_engineer_field_p1}+6 ammo per pouch. Test loads survive the march.
{=tor_engineer_field_p2}+15% ranged resist. Duck, brace, return fire.
{=tor_engineer_field_p3}+15% firearm speed. Hotter charges fly faster.
{=tor_engineer_field_p4}+1 map speed. Surveyor routes keep the column moving.
{=tor_engineer_explosive_key}Bullets burst on impact; Open Fire! throws blasts wider.
{=tor_engineer_explosive_p1}+6 ammo per pouch. Extra rounds for volatile work.
{=tor_engineer_explosive_p2}No ranged stagger. Shrapnel will not break your aim.
{=tor_engineer_explosive_p3}Ranged troops deal +10% damage under your firing tables.
{=tor_engineer_explosive_p4}+10% ranged pierce. Hardened shot finds the gap.
{=tor_engineer_suppression_key}Open Fire! covers more ground and steadies the line.
{=tor_engineer_suppression_p1}+6 ammo per pouch. Suppression needs deep pockets.
{=tor_engineer_suppression_p2}Ranged troops gain +10% resist while holding the line.
{=tor_engineer_suppression_p3}+10% gunpowder damage. Keep their heads down.
{=tor_engineer_suppression_p4}+10 party size. More barrels for the battery.
{=tor_engineer_grenadier_key}Every 7 explosive kills refunds a charge.
{=tor_engineer_grenadier_p1}+3 explosive charges per pouch. Pack them tight.
{=tor_engineer_grenadier_p2}+30% explosion radius. The blast grows greedy.
{=tor_engineer_grenadier_p3}+30% Fire damage. The fuse bites deeper.
{=tor_engineer_grenadier_p4}+30% explosive speed. Arcs flatten, fuses hurry.
{=tor_engineer_piercing_key}Bullets punch through and keep looking for trouble.
{=tor_engineer_piercing_p1}+6 ammo per pouch. Piercing work takes practice.
{=tor_engineer_piercing_p2}+25% ranged pierce. Measure armor, then ignore it.
{=tor_engineer_piercing_p3}+20% gunpowder damage. Pressure wins arguments.
{=tor_engineer_piercing_p4}Ranged troops deal +15% damage with drilled volleys.
{=tor_engineer_ricochet_key}Open Fire! turns rebounds into 30% detonation chances.
{=tor_engineer_ricochet_p1}+6 ammo per pouch. Spare shot for improbable angles.
{=tor_engineer_ricochet_p2}+15% ranged resist. Cover, angles and stubborn helmets.
{=tor_engineer_ricochet_p3}+30% firearm accuracy. Calculated rebounds start true.
{=tor_engineer_ricochet_p4}Ricochets always happen; 30% detonate; buckshot +3.
{=tor_engineer_fuses_key}Barrage learns to burn, linger and feed Open Fire!
{=tor_engineer_fuses_p1}Barrage: +10% damage, ignites, charges Open Fire!
{=tor_engineer_fuses_p2}Barrage burn lasts +2s and can stack twice.
{=tor_engineer_fuses_p3}Barrage cooldown -5s. The crews reload hot.
{=tor_engineer_fuses_p4}+30% Fire damage. Everything burns brighter.
{=tor_engineer_battery_key}Barrage fields +1 max gun and +1 shell per gun.
{=tor_engineer_battery_p1}Barrage fires +2 shells. The battery speaks longer.
{=tor_engineer_battery_p2}Barrage deals +10% damage. Heavier powder, harder fall.
{=tor_engineer_battery_p3}Barrage impacts cover a wider killing ground.
{=tor_engineer_battery_p4}Barrage fires +2 shells and reloads 5s sooner.
{=tor_engineer_cc_option}Imperial Engineer
{=tor_engineer_cc_effect}Engineer Career

{=tor_engineer_cc_flavour}You learned the sacred arithmetic of powder, bore and fuse in the Imperial gunnery schools. Now you take the field with rifle, shot and a doctrine simple enough for any soldier to understand: open fire.
{=tor_engineer_hub_dwarf_contraband_p}I have heard you can source contraband Dawi firearms. Can we arrange that?
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_upgrade_1}For 500{PRESTIGE_ICON} I can move Dawi handguns, bullets and blasting charges.
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_upgrade_2}Another 500{PRESTIGE_ICON} opens cannon, hand grenades, grudge-rakers, buckshot and drakefire pistols.
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_upgrade_3}A final 500{PRESTIGE_ICON} secures masterwork handguns, Dronazgrund, trollhammers and torpedoes.
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_complete}You already bought out every contraband contact I have. Browse my stock when you buy equipment.
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_agree}Very well. Grease the right palms (Spend 500{PRESTIGE_ICON}).
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_decline}I cannot afford that right now.
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_upgrade_1_done}The first crate is on its way. Ask to buy equipment when you are ready; the contraband will be mixed in quietly.
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_upgrade_2_done}Good. The second shipment should keep your gunline supplied for a long campaign.
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_upgrade_3_done}That is everything I dare move. Sigmar help us if the Guild ever traces it back to my forge.
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_decline_response}Come back when your purse and your reputation can bear it.
